messages:
maria: Thanks everyone for the all-hands today — great overview. Quick follow-up on security/privacy/compliance: can someone clarify three things? 1) SOC2 Type II timeline, 2) VPC/private control plane rollout schedule, and 3) whether audit logs will include per-request model/version metadata. Also, KMS key rotation/BYOK questions for Private — would love an office hours slot for customers + SREs.

security-bot: Uploaded the slides and a short SOC2 summary to the handbook: https://handbook.redwood.com/security/soc2. Also created a provisional office-hours signup form: https://cal.com/redwood/security-officehours — we'll firm up date after a couple of follow-ups.

anna: Short answers here, I can expand in a doc tomorrow: SOC2 Type II target = end of Q3 for audit window, controls in-place by early Q3. VPC private control plane beta = mid-June for a small set of customers, wider availability later in Q3. Audit logs: yes — log entries will include model_id and model_version fields, route, request_id, and token usage metadata. By default hosted tenants will get sanitized logs in Console > Audit; Private deployments can ship full audit logs to a customer-managed bucket.

devon: Adding infra details: audit-log schema v1 is live in the repo (will link). Example log snippet we plan to emit: ```{ "timestamp": "2026-06-15T12:34:56Z", "service": "redwood.inference", "model_id": "redwood-13b-v2", "model_version": "v2.1", "request_id": "req_01E3...", "route": "/v1/generate", "token_count": 42 }``` Use request_id to join with traces in our tracing backend. We'll package a BigQuery/ELK extractor for customers.

sam: Quick question — will audit logs include raw prompts? we need clarity for PII/redaction and GDPR compliance.

anna: Good catch. Hosted: by default prompts are redacted/truncated in audit exports; customers can opt in to full-text logs only with explicit Data Retention and consent (and we surface implications in the UI). Private: logs land in customer-managed storage — they control retention and whether full prompts are kept. For BYOK/HSM: Private supports customer-managed KMS; HSM-backed BYOK is part of our alpha roadmap (ETA: late Q3 for limited customers).

ops_jamie: Action items I heard: 1) Publish a short FAQ (SRE + customer-facing) covering SOC2 timeline, VPC beta, audit log schema and prompt redaction; 2) Schedule a 60-min office hours for customers + internal SREs; 3) Add a KB blurb for support. I'll draft the FAQ and propose two time slots. @maria can you own review?

maria: Yes I'll review. Also can we get a 1-pager for sales/solutions to set expectations for customers (what to say now vs what is coming)?

devon: I'll add a "customer talking points" section to the FAQ and a tiny checklist for onboarding (what telemetry we can provide now, how to enable Private/BYOK when available).

anna: Follow-ups from security: 1) I'll post the SOC2 control list and mappings to our services tomorrow. 2) KMS/BYOK doc with HSM roadmap will be published next week. 3) Office hours — propose Tue 2026-06-23 16:00 UTC and Wed 2026-06-24 09:00 UTC; we'll pick one after signups.

maria: :thumbsup: thanks all. cc support and solutions so they can update KB and playbook. If folks want early access to the VPC beta DM @devon.

security-bot: Noted actions: [FAQ draft], [Office hours], [SOC2 control list], [KMS/BYOK doc]. I'll convert this thread to a checklist and ping owners tomorrow at 14:00 UTC.

sam: Thanks — will share a short SRE checklist on what to monitor (request_id, token_count, error codes) once draft exists.

ops_jamie: Draft posted in #eng-infra later today, link will follow.

maria: Closing loop — appreciate the quick responses. If anyone else has immediate questions drop them here and we'll triage in the office hours.
